svg.text: Clean drinking water delivered by our own barge, Malik, to ships at
Running low on fresh water should never hold a ship up. Malik,
our own water barge, brings clean drinking water out to
vessels at Khorfakkan and Fujairah. Because we own and run
the barge ourselves, we set the schedule, not a third party.
